  SELECT
    pt.value,
    pt.name
  FROM photo_type pt
  WHERE lower(coalesce(pt.name, '')) LIKE '%' || 'star' || '%'
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,

  ON p.type = s.value
WHERE
  p.u IS NOT NULL
  AND p.g IS NOT NULL
  AND p.r IS NOT NULL
  AND p.i IS NOT NULL
  AND p.z IS NOT NULL
  AND (p.u - p.g) < 0.4
  AND (p.g - p.r) < 0.7
  AND (p.r - p.i) > 0.4
  AND (p.i - p.z) > 0.4

rows.question: What is the star in photometrically observed binary star system, of which the neighbor's distance is less than 0.05 and has the following constraints in its color bands, u - g < 0.4, g - r < 0.7, r - i > 0.4 and i - z > 0.4
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photoobj_clean_photometry AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid::bigint AS objid,
    p.ra::double precision AS ra,
    p.dec::double precision AS dec,
    p.u::double precision AS u,
    p.g::double precision AS g,
    p.r::double precision AS r,
    p.i::double precision AS i,
    p.z::double precision AS z,
    p.clean::integer AS clean
  FROM photoobj p
  WHERE p.u IS NOT NULL
    AND p.g IS NOT NULL
    AND p.r IS NOT NULL
    AND p.i IS NOT NULL
    AND p.z IS NOT NULL
    -- keep rows with valid positions as well
    AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
    AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
),
photoobj_colors AS (
  SELECT
    objid,
    u,
    g,
    r,
    i,
    z,
    (u - g) AS u_g,
    (g - r) AS g_r,
    (r - i) AS r_i,
    (i - z) AS i_z
  FROM photoobj_clean_photometry
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  n.neighborobjid,
  n.distance
FROM photoobj_clean_photometry p
JOIN photoobj_colors c ON c.objid = p.objid
JOIN neighbors n ON n.objid = p.objid
WHERE n.distance < 0.05
  AND c.u_g < 0.4
  AND c.g_r < 0.7
  AND c.r_i > 0.4
  AND c.i_z > 0.4
ORDER BY p.objid, n.distance

WITH photo_type_lookup AS (
  SELECT value, name
  FROM photo_type
),
photoobj_with_colors AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid,
    p.run,
    p.rerun,
    p.field,
    p.mode,
    p.type,
    p.clean,
    p.ra,
    p.dec,

  mode,
  type,
  clean,
  ra,
